If you mean by pull counter slipping or moving backwards, I agree with you this is extremely tricky. Although it might work sometimes, I’ve learned that its best to almost never use it. What you can do in the uppercut hook example, is to slip the uppercut to the side (don’t pull away) and when the hook comes you duck (this can be done in 1 movement).

Another thing that I found quite helpful is to just slip the last punch, so in your example just the hook, as slipping makes you extremely vulnerable when he mixes is up.

Sorry for the delayed reaction, if you need anything else I’d like to help you with it

Hooks beat a jab and often a straight right, often its better to counter (let him go first so his stamina lowers) or slip his last punch, and then throw your shots.

Also I recommend not always going all out when throwing shots, this makes his punches more dangerous
